brief: The Houthis have taken Perim Island inside Bab al-Mandeb after seizing Mocha and advancing down Yemen's Red Sea coast, adding a second shipping chokepoint alongside Hormuz, where another vessel was hit this weekend. Brent surged through $100 as markets priced a second front in the energy shock. The ULSD-WTI crack spread, the diesel refining margin, has broken above its 2022 energy-crisis highs; Goldman's trading desk says October ULSD rose over 8% from September 8-11, the front crack reclaimed its high, and open interest added $1.9bn, signaling fresh long exposure. Distillates are trading as if crude were near $140/bbl. Higher crude is pushing inflation expectations up, and diesel is showing up at the long end of the Treasury curve. As US retail diesel prices have risen, Trump's approval rating has deteriorated and prediction markets have raised the odds Democrats take the Senate; the note argues voters respond to pump prices, not spreads, so Houthis keeping diesel expensive through November could aid Democrats, with the House race called far tighter than individual Squad members' seats.
